# Sequences: BookShelf

Key interactions, using routes and handlers from `profile.json`.

## Sign in

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor Reader
    participant Browser
    participant AccountController
    Reader->>Browser: Enter email and password
    Browser->>AccountController: POST /account/login
    Note over AccountController: Current code does not verify credentials (TODO)
    AccountController-->>Browser: Redirect to /books
    Browser->>Reader: Show My Books
```

## Add a book

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    actor Reader
    participant Browser
    participant BooksController
    participant AppDbContext
    Reader->>Browser: Submit title, author and ISBN
    Browser->>BooksController: POST /books/create
    BooksController->>AppDbContext: Books.Add(book)
    BooksController->>AppDbContext: SaveChanges()
    BooksController-->>Browser: Redirect to /books
    Browser->>BooksController: GET /books
    BooksController->>AppDbContext: Books.ToList()
    AppDbContext-->>BooksController: Books
    BooksController-->>Browser: My Books page
```
